formChecks.e164NoPlus: {label}: start with + and the country code, for example +1 415 555 2671.
formChecks.e164NotNumber: {label}: {number} isn't a phone number. Check the country code and the number of digits.
formChecks.e164Unusual: {label}: {number} doesn't look like a real number for its country code. Check it before saving.
formChecks.leadNoCountryCode: No country code. Calls will assume the lead is in the same country as the number you call from. If the lead is elsewhere, the call fails: add the country code, for example +1 415 555 2671.
formChecks.leadNotNumber: {number} isn't a phone number: check the country code and the number of digits.
formChecks.leadUnusual: {number} doesn't look like a real number for its country code. The carrier may reject it.
formChecks.summaryNoCountryCode: {count, plural, one {# number has} other {# numbers have}} no country code ({examples}). They will be dialled in the country of the number you call from; add the country code to any lead that is elsewhere.
formChecks.summaryNotNumber: {count, plural, one {# number isn't a phone number} other {# numbers aren't phone numbers}} ({examples}). Calls to them will fail: fix them in the file first.
formChecks.summaryUnusual: {count, plural, one {# number doesn't look real} other {# numbers don't look real}} for their country code ({examples}). The carrier may reject them.
